description: Which Windows kernel a memory image runs (PDB name, GUID, age, as Volatility's automagic names it) and whether this image holds its symbol table; offline, nothing fetched. A missing table is said plainly and stops a kickoff unless --allow-missing-symbols.
covers: The identity of a Windows memory image's kernel (the PDB Volatility's automagic names) and whether the image holds its symbol table, from one offline windows.info. Not covered: what any other plugin reports, Linux and macOS images, and a capture Volatility cannot stack a Windows layer on.
